value.hook: before probing prod or editing in a wave worktree
value.title: Worktree edits, prod probes, prefetch and git-launch tracing

sections.name: body
sections.value:
Lessons from coder/home-prefetch (nav wave 1, 2026-11-12):

- Worktree work in an omp seat: the edit/read tools resolve relative paths against the main tree (/Users/jordanknight/substrate/chainglass), not your worktree. Use absolute worktree paths for every edit, or you silently edit Jordan's hot-reloaded main tree.
- Probing a prod build in a browser needs the bootstrap cookie: POST /api/bootstrap/verify {code} with the code from <worktree>/.chainglass/bootstrap-code.json, then pass the Set-Cookie pair to curl and the Playwright context. Without it every page is the gate popup (looks like "0 prefetches").
- Next 16.4.2 prefetch: each prefetched link = 2 requests (/_tree, then metadata). Visible prefetchable links are all re-prefetched on router-tree change or a revalidating server action, so data-scaled link lists multiply; prefetch={false} on them.
- Counting git launches per server without root: put a logging `git` wrapper first in PATH and a NODE_OPTIONS --require preload that wraps child_process.spawn (syncBuiltinESMExports) to log stacks; start spare-port servers with TMUX unset and a private TMUX_TMPDIR.
- Idle git launch source was /api/worktree-activity (30 s poll per tab x all workspaces); GitWorktreeResolver now caches on git metadata stamps (web DI only).
